description: Add new backend API endpoints to serve checklist data in a grid/table format matching the paper forms (weekly W1-W5 per room per month, quarterly by month per room, daily Mon-Sun per room). The current API only returns tasks for a single date. New endpoints must return structured grid data showing all weeks/months with historical initials filled in.
steps: Add GET /api/checklists/weekly/:roomId endpoint in backend/src/routes.js that returns weekly tasks for a given room for the current month. Response: { room, month, year, tasks: [{name, w1: {done, initials, date}, w2: {...}, w3: {...}, w4: {...}, w5: {...}}] }. Determine week number within month by date. Look up completed_by staff initials from the staff table.

Add GET /api/checklists/quarterly/:roomId endpoint that returns quarterly deep clean tasks for a room for the current year. Response: { room, year, tasks: [{name, entries: [{month, initials, date}]}] }. Match template_id 'tpl_quarterly_deep'.

Add GET /api/checklists/daily/:roomId endpoint that returns daily tasks for a room for the current week (Mon-Sun). Response: { room, weekStart, tasks: [{name, days: [{day, done, initials, date}]}] }. Match template_id 'tpl_daily_room'.
Add GET /api/checklists/daily-communal/:areaId endpoint for communal area daily tasks (same format as daily room but for communal areas, template_id 'tpl_daily_communal').
Add optional query param ?month=YYYY-MM to weekly and ?year=YYYY to quarterly endpoints to allow viewing past periods.
Ensure all new endpoints require auth (use existing requireAuth pattern from routes.js).

Update the seed.js to also generate quarterly task instances - currently only daily, weekly, and door handle tasks are seeded. Add quarterly tasks for rooms 1-18 for months already passed in current year (e.g., if current month is June, seed March quarterly entries with completed status).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/checklists/weekly/room_1 returns a JSON object with room info, month, year, and a tasks array where each task has w1-w5 properties showing done/initials/date
GET /api/checklists/quarterly/room_1 returns a JSON object with year and tasks array where each task has entries array with month/initials/date
GET /api/checklists/daily/room_1 returns current week's daily tasks with Mon-Sun breakdown showing done/initials per day
All endpoints return 401 without valid auth token
Historical data shows initials (HS, RT, AN, DP) from seed data for past periods
verification: Start the server and manually test: curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"pin":"1234"}' to get a token, then curl with the token to /api/checklists/weekly/room_1 and verify it returns structured grid data with initials
Existing test.js tests should still pass (no breaking changes to existing endpoints)
